Changes (matching upstream fix for vuejs/core#11739):
- `packages/shared/src/escapeHtml.ts`: added `getEscapedCssVarName` (moved from compiler-sfc so runtime-core can use it)
- `packages/compiler-sfc/src/script/utils.ts`: removed the helper (now in shared)
- `packages/compiler-sfc/src/style/cssVars.ts:11`: import from `@vue/shared`
- `packages/runtime-core/src/hydration.ts:955`: `resolveCssVars` now escapes var names with `getEscapedCssVarName(key, false)` before adding them to the expected style map

Verification: the new "escape css var name" hydration test passes, and all 2063 tests across runtime-core, compiler-sfc, compiler-ssr, compiler-core, shared, and server-renderer pass (plus eslint on changed files).
